name: The Temporal Barrel

party_reactions.twist: A TIME BARREL?! That's WEIRD! I LOVE IT!

party_reactions.renna: The barrel contains temporal essence. Ancient. Conscious. Remarkable.
party_reactions.suresh: It contains the energy of ages. A lesson in containment. In patience.

party_reactions.senna: It knows secrets. Of all time. Valuable.
party_reactions.callum: Its containment protocols! ANCIENT! But EFFECTIVE!
